target_customer: Urban consumers in San Francisco seeking convenient preventive dental care
problem: Dental visits are hard to book and associated with upselling and anxiety; Rinse runs studios with same-day booking, app scheduling and prevention focused care.
business_model: Direct dental practice revenue from patients and insurance, with owned studios

founders.name: Casey Harlin
prior_employers: Delta Dental (8 years as VP of Product and Customer Experience)
founders.background_notes: YC page and launch post describe him as an engineer turned healthcare product executive.

competitors.name: Tend
competitors.what: New York based chain of modern dental studios with online booking
competitors.traction_then: Studios in New York, Washington DC, Boston, Atlanta and other cities per a later profile
competitors.funding_then: Raised a $37M Series B in January 2021

technical_complexity.rationale: Mostly a clinical operations business with a booking app; the hard parts were licensing, dentist hiring and studio buildout.

defensibility.rationale: Brand and location quality are copyable by Tend and other chains; patient relationships give modest switching costs.

market_need_then: The pitch was that dental care lagged One Medical style convenience; Tend raised $37M in January 2021 on a similar thesis, suggesting investor interest, though patient demand data was not found.

branding.domain_note: Uses rinse.dental because rinse.com belongs to an unrelated clothing care company.

identity.visual_style: Beautiful studios, hi-tech and prevention focused per its site tagline

branding.brand_signature: Hi-Tech, Prevention Focused tagline and One Medical for dental positioning
branding.community_and_virality: Referral program offering free whitening; no wider community found.

brand_strength.rationale: A short dental-fitting word and clear positioning, but it collides with an unrelated Rinse brand and no press about the brand itself was found.

outcome_analysis: Rinse opened a studio on Union Street in San Francisco around its 2021 launch and remains active with a small team and the Marina area focus, but no priced round, expansion or exit appears in reliable sources. The thesis of a One Medical for dental faces capital intensive studio growth, and with funding unknown the record shows a quiet operating clinic rather than a clear success or failure.
notes: Aggregators list a $125K pre-seed in August 2021 (Goodwater, Y Combinator, Liquid 2) and YC lists Optum Ventures, PJC and Global Founders Capital as backers; no amounts or dates verified, so no rounds recorded. Caplight, Crunchbase style pages show Series A to D rounds that belong to the unrelated rinse.com clothing care company and are excluded. Tend details come from a January 2021 beauty trade piece and a later multiples.vc profile. Founder education not found. Brand name origin not found.
